The '''Student Culinary Club''' was a student organization at the [[Coruscant Institute for Medical Sciences]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The club provided refreshments at a lecture by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tan Kirin]].
